environment: macOS Darwin 25.6.0, Python 3.14.7, git 2.50.1, Node test runner; branches.py run as python3 script from the verifier worktree at sdlc/S-004 2b1960c through testkit cli-runner (scratch HOME, TZ=UTC, PYTHONUTF8=1)

cases.title: Default format names the run, slice, milestone, e2e and e2e-area branches
cases.given: A scratch git repo with no .sdlc/config.json and no --format
cases.when: branches.py name runs once per kind with the acceptance arguments
cases.then: Each run exits 0 with one JSON object
cases.expected: sdlc/run-1, sdlc/S-001, sdlc/M-1, sdlc/M-1-e2e, sdlc/M-1-e2e-api; keys ok, command, format, kind, branch; empty stderr; git check-ref-format accepts each
cases.actual: All five match; stderr empty; tree and refs unchanged

evidence.title: key output
evidence.inline:
--kind run --n 1 -> exit 0 {"ok": true, "command": "name", "format": "sdlc/{name}", "kind": "run", "branch": "sdlc/run-1"}
--kind milestone --id M-1 -> exit 0 branch sdlc/M-1
--kind e2e --id M-1 -> exit 0 branch sdlc/M-1-e2e
--kind e2e-area --id M-1 --area api -> exit 0 branch sdlc/M-1-e2e-api
--kind slice --id S-001 -> exit 0 branch sdlc/S-001

attacks.title: Decoy module import from cwd
attacks.detail: Decoy json, argparse, subprocess, os and re modules in the cwd during 810 hostile runs. No decoy fired.

seeds.title: Accepted milestone ids and e2e areas give branches git check-ref-format refuses
seeds.detail: 109 of 270 accepted hostile values give a branch git refuses, for example sdlc/../.., sdlc/a b, sdlc/M-1-e2e-a\nb. The format check probes only S-001. ADR-20261009-045048 accepts this gap. A consumer that pushes such a name fails late at git. List: .sdlc/slices/S-004/verification/r0/logs/cli-0-TC-cli-9-git-refused.txt

seeds.title: Run counter accepts unicode digits, padding and a negative sign
seeds.detail: argparse int accepts ' 3', '+1', '1_000', Arabic-Indic and fullwidth digits, and -1. -1 gives sdlc/run--1 (ADR-20261009-045048). A 4301-digit counter exits 2 only through the Python int string limit, with an error that echoes the full value.

seeds.title: Error text uses 'a e2e' and 'a e2e-area'
seeds.detail: The missing-part error reads 'a e2e branch name needs a non-empty id'. The article is wrong before a vowel sound. Cosmetic.
